d: Watch as Firstpost examines Israel's high-stakes diplomatic move on the Gulf of Aden, becoming the first UN member state to formally send an ambassador to Somaliland. As Israeli Ambassador Michael Lotem presented his credentials in Hargeisa and laid the foundation for a future embassy, Somaliland’s 35-year quest for international recognition hit a dramatic turning point. Commanding over 850 kilometres of coastline opposite Yemen and near the crucial Bab el-Mandeb strait, Somaliland’s strategic position in countering Houthi maritime threats has drawn intense global focus.
